description: Section outlines for LLM generation — one entry per policy type. Used with prompts/generate_section.j2.

sections.title: Purpose and Scope
sections.instructions: Explain who the policy applies to (full-time, part-time, contractors where relevant) and the company commitment to work-life balance.

sections.title: Annual Leave Entitlement
sections.instructions: State the annual leave days for full-time employees and how probation affects entitlement accrual or usage.

sections.title: Sick Leave
sections.instructions: Describe sick leave allocation, notification requirements, and medical certificate rules if applicable.

sections.title: Carry Forward and Year-End
sections.instructions: Explain carry-forward limits, year-end forfeiture rules, and manager approval for exceptions.

sections.title: Request and Approval Process
sections.instructions: Describe how employees request leave, minimum notice periods, and manager/HR approval workflow.

sections.title: Purpose and Eligibility
sections.instructions: Define remote work purpose, eligible roles, and hybrid expectations.

sections.title: Remote Schedule
sections.instructions: State allowed WFH days per week and core collaboration hours employees must be available.

sections.title: Equipment and Workspace
sections.instructions: Cover home office equipment allowance, ergonomic responsibilities, and company-provided hardware.

sections.title: Communication and Performance
sections.instructions: Set expectations for meetings, responsiveness, and performance measurement while remote.

sections.title: Security and Compliance
sections.instructions: Reference data handling, VPN use, and policy violations while working remotely.

sections.title: Introduction and Commitment
sections.instructions: State organizational values, professional behavior expectations, and applicability.

sections.title: Standards of Behavior
sections.instructions: Cover respect, anti-harassment, conflicts of interest, and use of company resources.

sections.title: Reporting Concerns
sections.instructions: Explain how to report misconduct, reporting window in days, and whether a whistleblower hotline exists.

sections.title: Training and Acknowledgment
sections.instructions: Describe mandatory conduct training frequency and employee acknowledgment requirements.

sections.title: Investigation and Consequences
sections.instructions: Outline investigation process, confidentiality, and disciplinary outcomes.

sections.title: Benefits Overview
sections.instructions: Summarize the benefits program and eligibility categories.

sections.title: Health and Dental Coverage
sections.instructions: Include a simple HTML table listing employer coverage percentages for health and dental insurance.

sections.title: Retirement and Savings
sections.instructions: Explain retirement plan match percentage and enrollment basics.

sections.title: Enrollment and Waiting Period
sections.instructions: State waiting period before benefits start and open enrollment windows.

sections.title: Changes and Continuation
sections.instructions: Cover life events, COBRA or local equivalent references, and plan change notices.

sections.title: Policy Scope
sections.instructions: Define reimbursable business expenses and non-reimbursable personal costs.

sections.title: Eligible Expenses
sections.instructions: List common eligible categories: travel, meals, supplies, with reasonable limits language.

sections.title: Receipts and Submission
sections.instructions: State receipt threshold, submission deadlines, and reimbursement SLA in business days.

sections.title: Approval Limits
sections.instructions: Explain pre-approval requirements above the single-expense limit and manager escalation.

sections.title: Audit and Non-Compliance
sections.instructions: Describe audit rights, duplicate claims, and consequences of policy violations.

sections.title: Performance Management Overview
sections.instructions: Explain goals of performance management and link to career development.

sections.title: Probation Period
sections.instructions: Define probation length, check-ins, and confirmation criteria for new hires.

sections.title: Review Cycle and Ratings
sections.instructions: State review frequency and describe the rating scale maximum.

sections.title: Performance Improvement Plans
sections.instructions: Explain PIP triggers, standard duration in days, and success criteria.

sections.title: Documentation and Appeals
sections.instructions: Cover record keeping, calibration, and employee appeal process.

sections.title: Welcome and Objectives
sections.instructions: Welcome new hires and state onboarding goals for first 30/60/90 day success.

sections.title: Onboarding Program Timeline
sections.instructions: Describe structured onboarding duration in business days and key milestones.

sections.title: Buddy and Mentor Program
sections.instructions: Explain buddy assignment duration in weeks and responsibilities.

sections.title: IT Provisioning and Access
sections.instructions: State target days for laptop, accounts, and system access provisioning.

sections.title: Compliance and First-Week Checklist
sections.instructions: List mandatory trainings, policy acknowledgments, and HR/IT checkpoints.

sections.title: Policy Overview
sections.instructions: Distinguish voluntary resignation, involuntary termination, and retirement.

sections.title: Notice Period
sections.instructions: State required notice period in days for voluntary resignation by level if needed.

sections.title: Severance Guidelines
sections.instructions: Explain severance weeks per year of service and eligibility conditions.

sections.title: Exit Process and Interviews
sections.instructions: Cover exit interview requirement, asset return, and final pay timeline.

sections.title: Post-Employment Obligations
sections.instructions: Reference confidentiality, non-solicitation where applicable, and reference checks.

sections.title: Purpose and Scope
sections.instructions: Define information security objectives and systems covered.

sections.title: Account and Password Standards
sections.instructions: State minimum password length and whether MFA is mandatory for all users.

sections.title: Device and Data Protection
sections.instructions: Require device encryption, lost device reporting, and removable media rules.

sections.title: Security Awareness Training
sections.instructions: State phishing and security training frequency in months.

sections.title: Incident Reporting
sections.instructions: Explain how to report suspected breaches and expected response timelines.

sections.title: Policy Scope and Approval
sections.instructions: Define business travel, pre-trip approval, and duty of care.

sections.title: Booking and Class of Travel
sections.instructions: State advance booking requirement and economy class rule based on flight duration hours.

sections.title: Per Diem and Lodging
sections.instructions: Include per diem amount and maximum hotel nightly rate; mention manager approval above limits.

sections.title: Ground Transportation and Meals
sections.instructions: Cover taxis, rental cars, meal caps, and alcohol exclusion.

sections.title: Expense Reporting After Travel
sections.instructions: Link to expense submission deadlines and required documentation after trips.
